question: On 5 April 2022, who was appointed as the Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission?
solution:
The correct answer is __Manoj Soni.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Dr Manoj Soni has been appointed as the Chairman of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC).
 
• He is currently a member of the UPSC.
 
• He served as the country's youngest Vice-Chancellor in 2005, of MS University.
 
• He also served as the Vice-Chancellor of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University in Ahmedabad between August 2009 to July 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Suman K Bery:**

 
• NITI Aayog’s Vice Chairman Rajiv Kumar has stepped down after being at the helm of the institution for nearly five years.
 
• Dr. Suman K Bery has been appointed new Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog.
 
• He will take charge as Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog from **1 May 2022.**
 
• Suman K Bery had earlier served as Director-General of the National Council of Applied Economic Research (NCAER) in New Delhi.
 
• NCAER is one of the country’s leading independent non-profit policy research institutions.
